items.title: Digging deep, working together
items.description: Editor's note: The 2026 China Mining Conference and Exhibition opens in Tianjin on Thursday and will run until Saturday. Over the three days, 28 forums will be held and the exhibition area will cover 65,000 square meters. On this page, we've invited Liu Guohong, Party secretary of the Ministry of Natural Resources of China, which hosts the event, and six senior officials of foreign countries to share their thoughts on the prospects of the industry.
